the gating of the mitochondrial voltage-gated VDAC channel involves the translocation of a domain from the membrane interior to the membrane surface and that the translocation is limited to one side of the membrane.

the gating of VDAC channels, which is a voltage-gated channel in the outer mitochondrial membrane.
